tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search Launchator's directory of SaaS, AI and indie products by what they do (e.g. 'invoicing for freelancers', 'screen recorder'). Returns the best matches with links.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details of one product listed on Launchator: description, website, category, tags and upvotes.

tools.name: alternatives_to
tools.description: Products on Launchator similar to a given listed product (same category or tags).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Launchator's product categories with how many products each has.

tools.name: submit_product
tools.description: Start a free Launchator listing for the user's own website. Loads the homepage, screens it, and drafts the listing (takes about 30 seconds). Returns the draft and the next step. Needs an access token.

tools.name: list_my_products
tools.description: The user's own Launchator listings and drafts, with their status and next step. Needs an access token.

tools.name: get_my_product
tools.description: One of the user's own listings or drafts. Needs an access token.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: Change the text of the user's listing. Only pass the fields to change. Logos and screenshots are changed in the browser (editInBrowser link). Needs an access token.

tools.name: get_badge_snippet
tools.description: The HTML link the product's homepage must carry for a free listing, as a text link or a badge image. Add one to the site footer. Needs an access token.

tools.name: verify_backlink
tools.description: Checks the live homepage for the Launchator link and, if it's there, publishes the listing. Call after the site with the link is deployed. Needs an access token.

tools.name: publish
tools.description: Re-checks whether a listing with a verified link can go live, e.g. after the founder confirmed their email. Needs an access token.

tools.name: check_ai_ready
tools.description: Free check of how well AI assistants and search engines can read and recommend the user's live product site: robots.txt rules for AI crawlers, server-rendered content, structured data, llms.txt, meta tags and more, with a score, the top fixes and copy-ready code. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_badge_snippet · Private data: submit_product, list_my_products, get_my_product, update_listing, get_badge_snippet, verify_backlink, publish, check_ai_ready · Public sink: submit_product, publish.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_badge_snippet · Private data: submit_product, list_my_products, get_my_product, update_listing, get_badge_snippet, verify_backlink, publish, check_ai_ready · Public sink: submit_product, publish

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
